name: Shimei
description: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy

points: The sons of Simeon are set down, and the record notes that Shimei had sixteen sons and six daughters, but his brethren had not many children.

note.label: 1 Chronicles 4: The Families of Judah and Simeon
